title: Global Fintech Fest 2026: RBI Governor says fintech has taken banking from branch to hand
description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said fintech has fundamentally reshaped Indian finance over the past decade, taking banking from branches to citizens’ hands and making financial inclusion a lived reality for hundreds of millions of Indians. He said fintech has also reduced transaction costs and settlement times, strengthened fraud detection through artificial intelligence and improved credit delivery to MSMEs.
